articles.title: LeBron James' son Bryce gets first taste of Arizona basketball as Wildcats begin showing their hand
articles.summary: Bryce James started Arizona’s first three games, then watched the next two from the bench.
articles.body: Bryce James started Arizona’s first three games, then watched the next two from the bench. The redshirt freshman and youngest son of LeBron James did not play at Auburn last Friday or in the 85-79 win over No. 3 UConn on Wednesday. Coach Tommy Lloyd has said the 6-foot-5 guard is healthy and that game flow kept him out. Before that, James averaged 2.7 points in 12.3 minutes. Arizona is 4-1 now, and Lloyd says the staff will keep looking for ways to get him back on the floor.Why is Bryce James getting fewer minutes at Arizona?The short answer is the rotation. Arizona beat UConn 85-79 for the Huskies’ first loss, and Lloyd rode his starters to do it. All five reached double figures behind 20 points from Ivan Kharchenkov. Only three reserves played, for 17 minutes combined. James was not one of them, just as he was not at Auburn last Friday.Lloyd spoke about that one afterward. “I wish I would have got him in the game,” he said. Arizona had built a lead playing one way, Auburn rallied, and Lloyd felt it was hard to throw in a player who had barely been on the court. He went with the group that had earned the lead.Nothing points to an injury, and the opponent explains plenty. UConn came in ranked third, so the starters stayed on the floor. The change stands out. The guard was in the opening five for the first three games, and Lloyd had been sorting his rotation while forward RJ Godfrey waited on word about his eligibility.What James has shown when he has playedThe flashes are real, even if the minutes are small. Against Northern Arizona on Nov. 10, James swung over to block a two-handed dunk attempt from Lucas Toukam, and the McKale Center crowd roared. He knocked down a 3-pointer from the wing shortly after. Arizona won that game 90-59.The passing has stood out too. He threw a no-look pass to Ugnius Jarusevicius for a layup in that game and a fast-break bounce pass to Kharchenkov against UCLA. Lloyd has also said the guard has shown him a lot over the past couple of weeks.His father has noticed. LeBron posted on Instagram after a game, writing “1% each day Young” with a crown emoji. The son came in as a three-star recruit from Sierra Canyon and spent last season as a redshirt while Arizona reached the Final Four. The defense is where he helps most right now, and the offense is still catching up. Lloyd has kept the spotlight off him.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: ‘You gonna let them win?’: Stephen A. Smith sparks race row over Lakers’ championship chances
articles.summary: Stephen A.
articles.body: Stephen A. Smith is facing fresh criticism after questioning whether Black NBA players will allow the Los Angeles Lakers to win a championship because three of the team’s leading players are white. Smith made the remarks on ESPN’s First Take on Wednesday, November 18, as the Lakers held a 13-2 record. ESPN analyst Jay Williams called the comments disturbing and said they brought back the kind of thinking sports had spent generations trying to leave behind. Smith later pushed back at Williams on X and said he stood by his words and his original view.Jay Williams Calls Stephen A. Smith’s Lakers Comments DisturbingSmith’s latest remarks followed comments on his podcast the previous week. He said he had never seen an NBA champion led by three white players and predicted the Lakers would not win the title this season.The team’s leading trio is Luka Doncic, Austin Reaves and Walker Kessler. Smith has praised their ability, but keeps bringing up their race when explaining his doubts about their title chances.On Wednesday’s First Take, Smith praised the Lakers’ strong start and named head coach JJ Redick as a possible Coach of the Year. He then turned to Black players around the league.“I’m looking at the brothers, and I’m saying, LA doing special things… these white brothers can play, y’all gonna let them win a championship?” Smith asked.Williams, an ESPN basketball analyst who sometimes appears on First Take, criticised the remarks in a post on X. He compared Smith’s words to racial talk from the 1930s and 1940s.Williams said athletes had spent generations fighting to be judged by talent rather than skin color. He questioned why Black players were being asked whether they should allow white players to win.“At what point does fighting against discrimination turn into perpetuating the same mentality we fought so hard to overcome?” Williams wrote.Stephen A. Smith Stands by His Words as Fans Push BackSmith responded on X and made it clear that Williams had not changed his mind. He thanked his colleague but said the comparison with the 1930s did not address his point.“I love this challenge to the fellas,” Smith wrote. “I want to see if this generation of players are gonna succumb to these Lakers. I said what I said and I meant what I meant.”He also challenged Williams to say whether his claim about a team led by three white players winning a title was wrong. He then said he was done discussing the matter.Viewers also criticised Smith. Some said race should not be part of a debate about a team’s chances. Others accused him of raising the subject to attract attention. One fan said sports should offer an escape from daily tensions.Smith has claimed that current and former NBA players privately agree with him. Some fans doubted that, arguing players are focused on winning games rather than stopping a team because of the race of its leading players.Fans also raised past NBA champions. The 1958 St. Louis Hawks had Bob Pettit, Slater Martin and Cliff Hagan among their key players. The 1980s Boston Celtics had Larry Bird, Kevin McHale and Danny Ainge, but also had Black Hall of Famer Robert Parish. Those teams do not provide a simple answer to Smith’s argument.Smith had earlier said a Lakers championship would be good for the NBA and Los Angeles ahead of the 2028 Summer Olympics. Still, he said he could not see a team with three white leading players winning the title.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: LeBron James celebrates Savannah James’ latest milestone in her career as she opens up about her skincare brand
articles.summary: LeBron James, the former Los Angeles Lakers’ icon, has been married to his wife, popular entrepreneur, for close to two decades.
articles.body: LeBron James, the former Los Angeles Lakers’ icon, has been married to his wife, popular entrepreneur, for close to two decades. While Savannah James has been there for him through all the challenges he has faced in his personal and personal life, LeBron James has now stepped up to be there for her as she achieves success in her career.LeBron James stands by his wife, Savannah James, as she achieves success with her skincare brand, Reframe BeautyA few hours ago, the Philadelphia 76ers’ star player LeBron James took to his social media to make a post about his wife, Savannah James, as she has recently sat for an interview about her successful skincare brand, Reframe Beauty.This is not the first time that the four time NBA champion have cheered on his wife, Savannah James, in public.Savannah James opens up about why she launched her skincare line as LeBron James stands by her sideIn the recent interview with Inc, LeBron James’ wife Savannah James opened up about the success of her skincare brand, Reframe Beauty, as she said, “I feel like sometimes the level of seriousness comes down to who is the face of what these brands are…I didn’t want that to be a hindrance to the efficacy of the products.”She added, “Just give me one step; I promise you it will be a game changer,” she shared. “I want you to be able to add it into your existing routine and see for yourself.”In another interview with Elle, the popular entrepreneur Savannah James opened up about why she launched a skincare line instead of a makeup line as she said, I believe that the foundation is the most important. I think that when you take care of your skin, it takes care of you. We have to protect our skin. That’s not to say that I wouldn’t extend into makeup or even hair care, but I definitely wanted to start with the basics.”The popular entrepreneur added, “It’s totally different! With Reframe, I’m putting my name and face on it and asking people to trust me with using it on their skin. It’s very nerve-racking, but I have complete faith in what we’ve created.”In many of her interviews, LeBron James’ wife Savannah James has also spoken about how the NBA icon motivated her to launch her own brand after staying out of the spotlight for years.While LeBron James’ move to the Philadelphia 76ers has sparked a debate, his wife Savannah James has spoken about how she and their daughter have preferred to live in their Los Angeles mansion as he plays for his new team.It has raised eyebrows among fans but both LeBron James and his wife, Savannah James, have stayed away from the drama.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: El coloso Great Osobor ve la luz casi un año después de su terrible lesión
articles.standfirst: El pívot, que se destrozó la rodilla izquierda en su segundo partido con la selección, publica un esperanzador vídeo en el que se observan sus grandes evoluciones
articles.summary: El pívot, que se destrozó la rodilla izquierda en su segundo partido con la selección, publica un esperanzador vídeo en el que se observan sus grandes evoluciones
articles.body: Hace casi un año que Great Osobor sufrió una gravísima lesión en su segundo partido con la selección española: esguince del ligamento lateral interno de la rodilla izquierda, rotura radial del cuerno anterior del menisco externo y rotura del ligamento cruzado anterior de esta misma articulación. Un diagnóstico devastador. Después de una larga y durísima recuperación, el coloso de 2,03 metros y 23 años nacido en Tudela empieza a ver la luz. En su cuenta en Instagram ha publicado un vídeo con alguna imagen de su lesión y con parte de su entrenamiento. Muchos ejercicios de fuerza para recuperar la musculatura perdida, trabajo en pista, tiro, contundentes mates... Una invitación al optimismo. "Esto sólo es un capítulo de mi historia, no el final", sentenciaba el pívot en una charla con MARCA a finales de junio. Si todo va bien, cada vez está más cerca el día en que volverá a escribir. Tras lesionarse aquel 30 de noviembre en un partido de las Ventanas FIBA ante Georgia, Osobor fue operado en Madrid por el prestigioso doctor Manuel Leyes. Después pasó seis semanas en Berlín y más tarde se trasladó a Estados Unidos, donde ha estado haciendo su recuperación. Todo bajo la supervisión de la Federación Española de Baloncesto con Elena Isla, directora del Área Médica, al frente. El seleccionador Chus Mateo también ha estado pendiente de su evolución. "Es muy importante para mí que estén pendientes. Me mandan mensajes, hablamos y eso me motiva para seguir trabajando todos los días", contaba. "No hay plazos", decía entonces. Más de cuatro meses después, las imágenes publicadas en sus redes sociales muestran una evolución muy positiva, pero él sigue yendo con calma. "In no rush" ("sin prisa"), escribió junto al vídeo. También sin pausa, con el regreso como objetivo y el sueño de poder jugar de nuevo con la selección. Su contrato con el Science City Jena alemán, su primer equipo profesional tras dejar la NCAA, finalizó el 30 de junio. La temporada pasada promediaba 16,1 puntos, 4,3 rebotes y 1,7 recuperaciones hasta que se lesionó. Cuando esté totalmente recuperado tendrá que encontrar un destino. "Lo más importante sería jugar en una situación que me ayudé a seguir creciendo como jugador y como persona. Si el próximo destino es en la ACB, me encantaría", dejaba caer quien, pese a ser tudelano, no contaría como cupo: "No tengo claro cómo funciona, pero a veces hay situaciones especiales. Yo nací en España".

articles.title: "I'm just disappointed": Is the news of LeBron James expressing disappointment in GTA 6 true amid his impressive performance?
articles.summary: LeBron James, the 41 year old NBA icon, has remained focused on his career while playing for the Philadelphia 76ers.
articles.body: LeBron James, the 41 year old NBA icon, has remained focused on his career while playing for the Philadelphia 76ers. While he has recorded a pretty impressive performance in the ongoing season, LeBron James has been dragged into GTA 6 drama.Has LeBron James expressed disappointment in GTA 6 amid its record breaking release?No, the four time NBA champion, LeBron James has not made any comments about the release of GTA 6 yet.In the last few hours, various parody pages have made fake posts about LeBron James’ alleged comments about GTA 6 when he has remained silent about it.A parody page on X made a post that read as, “LeBron James On GTA 6—Says He is Disappointed: "Honestly, man, I’m just disappointed. You got millions of people….myself included…..who waited 13 years for this game expecting something way more sophisticated, with next-level, groundbreaking graphics. To make the fans wait over a decade, charge $100 for the base game, and then come out with basic graphics?”The fake post added, “That’s crazy to me. It feels like they got lazy because they knew people were gonna buy it off the name alone. Look at what other studios are doing right now, and then you look at this …..it looks like a glorified DLC from 2013. When you’re at the top, there’s a standard you gotta uphold, and right now, Rockstar is coasting off legacy instead of delivering greatness. Fans deserve way better than a cash grab."Despite the post being completely made up, many fans have already believed it.A fan commented, “He’s absolutely right! GTA 6 is the biggest scam—making players wait 10 years just to be disappointed!”Another fan wrote, “Lebron is saying this!!! This should tell u all something about GTA.”However, the 41 year old four time NBA champion LeBron James has not addressed the fake rumors related to him yet.Interestingly, in 2023, LeBron James had taken to his social media to comment on an early GTA 6 trailer as his post on X read as, "GTA 6 looks INSANE!!!! SHEESH".While it has been rumored that LeBron James is a fan of Grand Theft Auto, he has never made any remarks about it in public except for a post on the trailer.LeBron James records an impressive performance even at 41 years oldFor now, all eyes remain on LeBron James’ performance in the new season as he remains a force to be reckoned with on the court.In the 2026–27 NBA regular season, LeBron James is averaging 15.7 points, 6.8 rebounds, and 6.8 assists in 32.5 minutes per game across 12 appearances for the Philadelphia 76ers.In a recent post game interview, the star player complimented teammate Labaron Philon Jr. as he said, "He's our first-round draft pick. He's not a guy that's afraid of the moment as well…When his number was called, he came in and gave us some big-time minutes and big-time shots. He was big time in his minutes."Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: 3 months after retirement, 9-time NBA All-Star makes heartwarming Thanksgiving gesture through his Why Not foundation
articles.summary: Russell Westbrook spent Thursday in the rain at Jesse Owens Park, the South Los Angeles park where he grew up, handing out Thanksgiving meals and
articles.body: Russell Westbrook spent Thursday in the rain at Jesse Owens Park, the South Los Angeles park where he grew up, handing out Thanksgiving meals and groceries. It was the 14th annual giveaway from the Why Not? Foundation and the largest yet, with 1,500 families receiving holiday dinners and winter coats. The event came three months after the nine-time All-Star retired from the NBA, ending 18 seasons across seven teams, the last with the Sacramento Kings. Video shared by NBA reporter Joey Linn shows Westbrook loading food packages next to volunteers, even as the rain kept coming.Russell Westbrook’s giveaway grows to 1,500 familiesVolunteers packed the supplies Tuesday at It’s Bigger Than Us in Baldwin Hills Crenshaw Plaza, with backing from LA County Parks and Recreation, Los Angeles County and Cal Dental USA. By Thursday, the handout moved to the park, and Westbrook was there with family members, staff and volunteers.The bigger budget came from September, when the sixth annual Why Not? Poker Night in Las Vegas raised more than $900,500. Six years of the event now add up to nearly $3 million.The giveaway started at the park 14 years ago, and the foundation has shown up every November since, Westbrook said. “This is home.” With more to work with this year, the plan was easy: “why not give more back to the community?”For families picking up food and coats, the help can ease the cost of Thanksgiving dinner and winter gear.The park where Westbrook grew up and the court named for himLinn pointed to the park’s history in his post. Three years ago, Westbrook and the Clippers opened a community court there.The Clippers Foundation and LA County Parks marked the November 2023 opening, when the main court became the Russell Westbrook Community Court. The ceremony also completed 117 renovated Clippers Community Courts across LA County. Earlier that day, Why Not? gave out 1,000 Thanksgiving meals to families in need.Westbrook grew emotional that day while recalling basketball games at the park in football cleats, before heading back to the football field.The work is not new to Westbrook, who often did community work even while still playing.The career line ended at 20.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 8.0 assists and 1.6 steals per game. The résumé includes the 2017 MVP award, two scoring titles, three assists titles, nine All-NBA selections, an Olympic gold medal and the all-time triple-double record. Oklahoma City fans have their own history with Westbrook from the Thunder years, and the bond has outlasted the playing days there.Why Not? was founded in 2012 and works across community assistance, education, sports, youth development and mental health.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Is Jalen Brunson alright? Knicks’ star exits Timberwolves game following injury scare
articles.summary: Jalen Brunson left Thursday night’s game against the Minnesota Timberwolves early in the first quarter after taking a hit to the face from LaMelo Ball at
articles.body: Jalen Brunson left Thursday night’s game against the Minnesota Timberwolves early in the first quarter after taking a hit to the face from LaMelo Ball at Target Center. The Knicks guard went to the locker room with 9:19 left in the period and New York trailing 7-2. Brunson had not scored in his first three minutes. No diagnosis had been announced, and there was no word on a return. The scare came on the road after back-to-back wins over the Toronto Raptors, and New York was looking to extend its winning streak against one of the West’s better teams.What happened to Brunson against the Timberwolves?Jalen Brunson took the contact on a LaMelo Ball drive, less than three minutes into the game. He did not stay on the bench. The guard went inside for evaluation, and coach Mike Brown had to rework his rotation sooner than planned.Brunson had already come through one close call earlier in the week. In Tuesday’s 111-102 win at Toronto, he scored 31 points and appeared to twist an ankle on a four-point play late in the game. He recovered and New York finished the night on a 9-0 run. Before that, he hit a clutch basket in a 112-108 overtime win over the same Raptors.He came in averaging 27 points and 5.9 assists a game and had a central role in both Toronto wins. The Knicks lean on him to set up the offense and to manufacture shots when plays stall, so an early exit on the road is a real concern.Knicks lineup options if Brunson is outIf Brunson cannot return, Brown has a few places to turn. Jose Alvarado is an experienced point guard option, and Miles McBride can take extra minutes in the backcourt. Karl-Anthony Towns, Mikal Bridges and OG Anunoby could be asked to carry more of the scoring. No one on that list gives the Knicks what Brunson does, both as a scorer and as the player who makes the calls, which is why losing him, even for a stretch, would be hard to cover.Minnesota is not the easiest place to test that depth. The Timberwolves came in at 11-4 even without injured star Anthony Edwards. Ball has taken on more of the offense in that absence, giving the Wolves another creator in the backcourt.The night was also a homecoming for Towns, who spent nine seasons in Minnesota before joining New York. Brunson’s early exit pulled the attention away from that storyline. For the moment, the Knicks were waiting on an update about whether their floor leader would get back on the court.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Karl-Anthony Towns’ father plays surprise role as Knicks star extends remarkable record-breaking streak
articles.summary: Karl-Anthony Towns had a helping hand from an unexpected place in the Knicks’ 102-99 win over the Timberwolves on Thursday night.
articles.body: Karl-Anthony Towns had a helping hand from an unexpected place in the Knicks’ 102-99 win over the Timberwolves on Thursday night. His father, Karl Towns Sr., pulled him off the floor after an and-1 finish in the first quarter at Target Center in Minneapolis. The 31-year-old big man went on to score 22 points with 12 rebounds. It was the 15th straight double-double to open the season, a new franchise record. New York improved to 9-6 and has won three in a row. Only three points separated the teams at the final buzzer.Why did Karl Towns Sr. help Karl-Anthony Towns off the floor?Karl-Anthony Towns attacked the rim in the first quarter, finished through contact and drew the foul. He hit the floor on the play, and Karl Towns Sr. was close enough to reach down and help him up. The two shared a quick celebration at courtside, and cameras caught it. A clip of the moment was posted on social media.Towns went right at Minnesota inside the paint from the start. The Timberwolves are one of the better teams in the Western Conference, and the and-1 came early. Towns is in a third season with the Knicks and has played in the NBA since 2015. Target Center is an old stomping ground for him, and a family member was right there to see the win.Towns sets a Knicks record with 15 straight double-doublesTowns finished with 22 points, 12 rebounds, four assists and three blocks in 32 minutes. He made 9 of 20 shots and 2 of 8 from three, the one soft spot in the line. The rest sits close to the season averages of 21.2 points, 14.1 rebounds and 3.9 assists he took into the game.The Knicks have played 15 games, and Towns has a double-double in every one of them. Rebounding is the biggest piece of what he gives New York on defense. He is not a defensive anchor in the classic sense, but the three blocks helped.Jalen Brunson had an injury scare early, then finished with 21 points and seven assists. New York is defending its championship after a slow start, and the win moved the team to 9-6 and back into the playoff picture. The Knicks rest Friday and host the Portland Trail Blazers at Madison Square Garden on Saturday.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Watch KAT Drop Epic Wolves Quote on Video After Leading Knicks to Win Over Former Team
articles.summary: Karl-Anthony Towns led the New York Knicks to a win over his former team, the Minnesota Timberwolves, on Thursday, and he had the perfect quote ready to go after the game.
articles.body:
Karl-Anthony Towns led the New York Knicks to a win over his former team, the Minnesota Timberwolves, on Thursday, and he had the perfect quote ready to go after the game.

"I was raised by Wolves, but it was Knicks in 5 at the end," Towns said after the win.

Towns was drafted first overall by the Timberwolves in 2015 and turned into a perennial All-Star with them, but he was traded to the Knicks ahead of the 2024-25 campaign.

The trade has ultimately worked out well for Towns, as he helped the Knicks win their first title in 53 years last season.

articles.title: Damian Lillard scores season-high 33 points in first game vs. Bucks post-injury, leads Trail Blazers to win
articles.summary: Lillard's 33 points were a season high and his most since March 5, 2025.
articles.body:
The Portland Trail Blazers made the trek to Milwaukee last year to play the Bucks. Damian Lillard was present, even though he was sitting out the entire 2025-26 campaign — his first season back with the Trail Blazers — as he recovered from the Achilles tear he suffered while playing for the Bucks in their 2025 first-round playoff series .

Fiserv Forum aired a video tribute to Lillard amid that November 2025 meeting, and the nine-time All-Star received a standing ovation after it played that night.

Thursday marked the 36-year-old guard's first time taking the court against Milwaukee since his injury and his two-season stint with the Bucks. Lillard was subdued talking about the matchup in the lead-up to tip-off , but he came away with his best performance in 624 days.

March 5, 2025, was the last time Lillard had a 30-point game. He scored a season-high 33 points on Thursday in a 124-114 victory over a reeling and rebuilding Milwaukee (1-15).

Portland (10-5) bounced back after dropping consecutive games to the Minnesota Timberwolves.

So, on Thursday, Milwaukee fans watched their team lose its 12th straight game and Lillard shoot 10 of 18 from the field, including 5 of 12 from the beyond the arc.

Plus, another former Bucks player, Jrue Holiday — part of Milwaukee's NBA championship team in 2020-21 — put on a show of his own. He logged 22 points, 7 assists and 4 steals.

Holiday stepped back to hit a crucial jumper with about 5 ½ minutes to go. Another 36-year-old guard, Holiday went on to help the Trail Blazers create separation late, even coupling a steal with a layup .

Portland also got 27 points and seven rebounds from a much younger member of its backcourt: Scoot Henderson.

Milwaukee had four players score 15-plus points this time out. Tyler Herro led the way with 19, Kasparas Jakučionis and Nate Ament had 18 apiece and Ryan Rollins chipped in 15. Turner, notably, was out with a shoulder injury .

The lead changed hands incessantly on Thursday. Herro drew the Bucks within one at the 3:18 mark in the fourth quarter. The Trail Blazers, though, scored the final nine points, with Lillard netting the last two at the free-throw line.

articles.title: Tari Eason's relationship fallout gets costly as Rockets star seeks justice over allegedly stolen Rolex, Chrome Hearts and Louis Vuitton
articles.summary: Tari Eason's dispute with his former girlfriend has taken another legal turn, with the Houston Rockets forward now seeking financial compensation over a
articles.body: Tari Eason's dispute with his former girlfriend has taken another legal turn, with the Houston Rockets forward now seeking financial compensation over a collection of allegedly stolen luxury belongings. The 25-year-old NBA player claims the fallout from their relationship cost him expensive designer clothing, accessories and other valuables. The latest court action adds a financial dimension to a dispute that had already reached the courts over allegations of physical violence and property damage.Eason is now seeking to recover what he says he lost.What is Tari Eason seeking in the lawsuit against his ex-girlfriend?Tari Eason, the $81.5 million Rockets forward, is seeking compensation after accusing his former girlfriend, Marilyn Maritza Melo Rodriguez, of taking several luxury possessions from his rental property in June. According to the court filing, via TMZ, Eason alleges Rodriguez entered the property without permission, damaged his clothes with bleach and took expensive personal belongings.The list includes a $15,000 Louis Vuitton duffel bag, a Rolex watch, Chrome Hearts glasses and other valuables. Eason claims his former girlfriend has refused to return the items despite repeated requests from him and his attorney.The financial claim goes beyond the missing accessories. Eason estimates his total losses, including the damaged clothing, at no less than $92,000. He is seeking up to three times the amount in damages under California law, along with additional compensation and legal fees.The lawsuit puts a specific financial figure on the dispute. It also gives Eason another legal avenue to address property he claims was damaged or taken during the relationship fallout.How does the lawsuit connect to Eason's earlier restraining order?The latest filing follows a domestic violence restraining order request Eason made in July. In his earlier petition, the Rockets forward alleged Rodriguez punched him repeatedly in the face following an argument. He also claimed she damaged thousands of dollars' worth of his designer clothing by pouring bleach on it.Eason further alleged threats against his safety, claiming one of Rodriguez's friends contacted him and said she would "break both of my legs" and "kill me."He asked the court to restrict Rodriguez from approaching him, his home, workplace, vehicle and other locations. A judge granted a temporary restraining order, which also covered NBA facilities where Eason might play or practice.However, the allegations have been disputed. A source close to Rodriguez previously told TMZ her account was false and misleading, maintaining the reports did not accurately reflect her experience.The temporary restraining order is still in effect, with a hearing scheduled for July 29, 2027.For Eason, the latest lawsuit is about recovering property and seeking financial damages, while the earlier court action concerns his personal safety. The two proceedings reflect different aspects of a relationship dispute that has now developed into a substantial legal battle.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: No. 8 Houston holds on to win Players Era 8 championship despite Tyran Stokes-led push from No. 11 Kansas
articles.summary: The Cougars were up by as many as 24 points in the first half, but a furious comeback bid from the Jayhawks made it a 4-point game with 2:34 remaining.
articles.body:
Tyran Stokes, the Rivals industry ranking's No. 1 recruit in the 2026 class and a top NBA Draft prospect, took over in the second half Thursday night in the Players Era 8 championship at Las Vegas' Michelob ULTRA Arena.

Stokes fueled a head-turning comeback bid after No. 11 Kansas trailed No. 8 Houston by as many as 24 points in the first half.

The Jayhawks pulled within four points of the Cougars with a bit more than 2 ½ minutes remaining. Then Houston responded with an 8-0 run that effectively clinched what turned out to be a 92-83 victory .

Both teams were playing their third game in three days to cap the early-season tournament. The Cougars (6-0) came out on top and demonstrated that they're capable of winning a much more prestigious tourney in the spring. Kansas (5-1) will regroup and get another crack at the Cougars in Big 12 play on Feb. 1.

Earlier in the night, top-ranked Florida, which lost to Houston on Wednesday , won the Players Era 8 tournament's third-place game, defeating West Virginia 85-72 .

While Stokes picked up a couple early personals and navigated foul trouble down the stretch, the freshman guard finished with 22 points and 11 rebounds, logging his third consecutive double-double. His intensity went a long way in igniting the Jayhawks' surge, as he accounted for 15 points and eight boards in the second half alone.

Kansas also got 18 points from senior guard Dennis Parker Jr. and 17 from sophomore guard Leroy Blyden Jr. Those two went a combined 22 of 23 from the charity stripe.

Houston was paced by junior guard Mercy Miller. He clocked out with 21 points, 8 rebounds and 4 assists, connecting on four 3-pointers in the process. Senior forward Delrecco Gillespie wasn't far behind with 19 points and seven boards. Dedan Thomas Jr. came through in the clutch, warding off Kansas late. The senior guard paired a layup and jumper to give Houston breathing room after the Jayhawks were on the brink of making it one-possession game.

The Cougars dominated the opening 20 minutes of play Thursday. They scored 11 straight points while Kansas went more than four minutes without one.

After that, Kelvin Sampson's squad was ahead 15-3. Houston came in averaging 5.2 triples per game and had four of them less than eight minutes in. The Cougars simultaneously sped up and beat up the Jayhawks.

By intermission, Houston was up to 54 points, tied for the most Kansas has allowed in a first half under Bill Self, who's been at the helm since 2003-04.

Known for their physicality, the Cougars imposed their will on both ends of the floor in that opening period. Not only did their defense make things difficult for the Jayhawks, but their offense was unrelenting as well.

Houston doubled up Kansas in paint points 24-12 in the first half and outscored the Jayhawks in second-chance points 18-3 along the way.

Self's group punched back following halftime.

At the end of a 12-0 Kansas run, Stokes went coast-to-coast, slammed on the brakes and scored inside.

Later, he snagged a steal that ultimately led to a Blyden 3-pointer. In that same stretch, amid a 10-0 Jayhawks run, Stokes challenged a pass, resulting in a Houston turnover.

His valiant effort, as well as the one put forth by the Jayhawks as a whole, simply fell short. It would have been historic had they came back.

AP top-10 teams in the last 30 seasons, according to the ESPN broadcast, were 1,224-0 when leading by 20-plus points at halftime.

Houston didn't end up being the outlier.

articles.title: Barcelona - Estrella Roja: horario y dónde ver hoy en TV el partido de Euroliga
articles.standfirst: El conjunto azulgrana recibe al equipo serbio en una nueva jornada de la máxima competición continental
articles.summary: El conjunto azulgrana recibe al equipo serbio en una nueva jornada de la máxima competición continental
articles.body: El FC Barcelona y el Estrella Roja de Belgrado se enfrentan hoy, viernes 20 de noviembre, en una nueva jornada de la fase regular de la Euroliga. El conjunto azulgrana vuelve a competir en Europa después de visitar al Panathinaikos en una de las pistas más exigentes del continente. El Barça afrontó ese compromiso condicionado por las bajas de Umoja Gibson, Juan Núñez, Yoan Makoundou, Kevin Punter y Tosan Evbuomwan. Enfrente estará un Estrella Roja que ha mostrado una gran solidez durante este inicio de competición. El equipo de Belgrado llegó a la undécima jornada con un balance de siete victorias y tres derrotas, además de presentar la mejor defensa de la Euroliga en ese momento. El encuentro entre el FC Barcelona y el Estrella Roja, correspondiente a una nueva jornada de la Euroliga, se disputa hoy, viernes 20 de noviembre de 2026, a partir de las 20:30 horas, en horario peninsular español. El partido entre el Barcelona y el Estrella Roja se podrá ver en directo por televisión en España a través de M+ Baloncesto 2, canal de la plataforma Movistar Plus+. También se podrá seguir toda la actualidad de la Euroliga y el minuto a minuto del encuentro en MARCA.com. Tras el partido estarán disponibles la crónica, las declaraciones de los protagonistas, el resumen y las mejores jugadas. La retransmisión podrá seguirse igualmente en Radio MARCA.

articles.title: La pesadilla de un NBA con su ex: ataques con lejía, robos, un puñetazo...
articles.standfirst: Tari Eason (Houston Rockets) denuncia a su exnovia Marilyn Maritza Melo Rodríguez, que ya tiene una orden de alejamiento
articles.summary: Tari Eason (Houston Rockets) denuncia a su exnovia Marilyn Maritza Melo Rodríguez, que ya tiene una orden de alejamiento
articles.body: Tari Eason, alero de los Houston Rockets, ha llevado a su exnovia a los tribunales acusándola de verter lejía sobre su ropa de marca y robarle una pequeña fortuna en artículos de lujo. TMZ ha tenido acceso a los documentos judiciales presentados por Eason contra Marilyn Maritza Melo Rodríguez. El jugador de los Rockets sostiene que en junio ella entró sin permiso en la propiedad que él tenía alquilada, destruyó gran parte de su ropa al verter lejía sobre ella y se apropió de varios objetos de gran valor (una bolsa de viaje Louis Vuitton valorada en 15.000 dólares, un reloj Rolex, unas gafas de la marca Chrome Hearts y otros objetos de valor). Tari Eason asegura haber sufrido pérdidas de al menos 92.000 dólares, incluyendo el valor de la ropa que resultó dañada, y reclama una indemnización que podría ascender al triple de esa cantidad, además de otros conceptos y el pago de los honorarios de sus abogados. El alero de los Rockets, que lleva cinco temporadas en la NBA promediando 10,4 puntos y 6,3 rebotes por partido, ya solicitó una orden de alejamiento por violencia doméstica contra Marilyn, alegando que ella le propinó un puñetazo en el rostro.

articles.title: La "MAGA Barbie" de la WNBA, candidata a "nueva chica Bond"
articles.summary: Sophie Cunningham, escolta que ha finalizado contrato con las Indiana Fever de la WNBA, expresó su interés en convertirse en la "próxima chica Bond".
articles.body: Sophie Cunningham, escolta que ha finalizado contrato con las Indiana Fever de la WNBA, expresó su interés en convertirse en la "próxima chica Bond". El exnadador Riley Gaines, conocido activista conservador, ha propuesto a la agente libre de la WNBA conocida como "MAGA Barbie" (por su apoyo a Donald Trump) como candidata a "chica Bond". Amazon MGM Studios reveló que Robert Pattinson sucederá a Daniel Craig como el próximo James Bond, lo que ha despertado un mayor interés por los papeles que tradicionalmente rodean a este icónico personaje. La última "chica Bond", un personaje llamado Doctora Madeleine Swann, fue interpretada por la actriz Léa Seydoux en la película de 2021 'Sin tiempo para morir' (No Time To Die).

articles.title: "Things are going to change": Steve Kerr opens up about the Warriors’ losing streak as Stephen Curry’s absence continues to hurt the team
articles.summary: Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors’ star player, remains sidelined from the court amid the brutal injuries he sustained in in the first quarter of
articles.body: Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors’ star player, remains sidelined from the court amid the brutal injuries he sustained in in the first quarter of the team’s game against the Houston Rockets. Since Stephen Curry has been sidelined, the Golden State Warriors have struggled on the court as the team have consectively witnessed back to back losses against the Houston Rockets, San Antonio Spurs, New Orleans Pelicans, Dallas Mavericks, and Memphis Grizzlies. Amid all the mess, the team’s head coach Steve Kerr has reflected on it.Golden State Warriors’ head coach Steve Kerr reflects on the team’s performance as they struggle without Stephen CurryA few hours ago, the Golden State Warriors’ head coach Steve Kerr spoke to ESPN’s Anthony Slater as he said, "I don't care about 1A, 1B, 2A [pecking order…None of that matters if you're not taking care of your business.”Golden State Warriors’ head coach Steve Kerr added, “We need to win in the margins [now], then [later], you can start talking about Jimmy and Yaxel and Steph and all three of them with the ability to close a game. Now, we got something. Now, we can compete with anybody. But at this stage, we're the furthest from there."In another instance, as Steve Kerr spoke to reporters at the American Airlines Center as he said, “This is just where we are right now…We’re wiped out with injuries. The guys are really, really competing and playing hard and staying together, and that’s all we can do. Things are going to turn, but we’ve got to give ourselves the best chance to help them turn.”Despite Steve Kerr’s reassurances, the Golden State Warriors have been brutally trolled by the team for failing to perform without the NBA icon Stephen Curry.When can Stephen Curry return to the court amid his brutal injury?As per reports, the Golden State Warriors will formally re-evaluate his right oblique tear two weeks after the initial diagnosis, with head coach Steve Kerr confirming a medical update will be shared on Thanksgiving Day.Since oblique tears typically require extended recovery time to avoid re-injury, ESPN's Shams Charania reported that the Warriors expect Stephen Curry to miss closer to a full month from his November 11 injury putting his realistic return around December 11.There are no confirmations by the team on his return yet.Stephen Curry has also stayed out of the spotlight as he has remained focused on his injury.A few days ago, in an interview, the four time NBA champion reflected how last season’s injury was equally painful as he said, "Against Detroit, it took everything in me down there on the training table just to be like, 'Oh, I can go out here tonight and play…’”The four time NBA champion added, “And I was just faking it for the first whatever (25 minutes)."Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: LeBron James’ Bucket Restaurant marks its first holiday season with a festive surprise for the Akron community
articles.summary: LeBron James, the four time NBA champion, has remained busy with his impressive performance with the Philadelphia 76ers while his efforts to improve
articles.body: LeBron James, the four time NBA champion, has remained busy with his impressive performance with the Philadelphia 76ers while his efforts to improve conditions in his hometown in Ohio have continued. Amid the holiday season, the LeBron James Family Foundation’s Bucket Restaurant has made a new announcement.LeBron James’ Bucket Restaurant marks the holiday season for the first time since their launch in AprilA few hours ago, the LeBron James Family Foundation’s Bucket Restaurant took to social media to make a post that read as, “Jingle all the way to Buckets because the holiday pop-up is HERE! 🎄✨ The garland is glowing, the ornaments are shining, and we’ve turned up the holiday cheer to fill Buckets with a little extra magic this time of year.”The post added, “The festive fun starts TODAY, so grab your favorite people, come hungry, and let the holiday celebrations begin. Oh, what fun it is to get Buckets! 😁❤️”Buckets Restaurant was launched by LeBron James’ foundation to help families coming from underprivileged conditions in AkronFor the unversed, the Buckets Restaurant is a charitable comfort food restaurant opened by the LeBron James Family Foundation in Akron, Ohio, designed to provide hands on job training and employment to local families.Located inside the foundation’s House Three Thirty community center on West Market Street, the gastropub opened on April 1, 2026, and is staffed largely by students, graduates, and parents from the foundation's I PROMISE Program, including former program ambassadors working in leadership and culinary roles.The restaurant serves accessible, scratch made comfort food, such as buckets of buttermilk fried chicken, wings, smashburgers, and a signature cookie with every menu price ending in .23 as a nod to James's jersey number.Apart from these, Buckets also operates as a sustainable workforce development hub that empowers low-income Akron residents to build careers in the hospitality industry.The former Los Angeles Lakers’ icon LeBron James remains closely associated with the organisation as he continues to serve the people of Akron.In a press release, Michele Campbell, executive director of the LeBron James Family Foundation, reflected on Buckets Restaurant as she said, “We were charged with changing the trajectory of students who were struggling in school…We learned pretty quickly the only way to do that was to wrap around the whole family unit.”Aaron Blank, director of culinary for House Three Thirty added, "All of our teammates put a lot of effort into this menu, and I would promote every dish, because every single staff member contributed to recipes…”For now, LeBron James remains focused on his performance with the Philadelphia 76ers.In the 2026–27 NBA season with the Philadelphia 76ers, LeBron James is averaging 15.7 points, 6.8 rebounds, and 6.8 assists per game across 12 appearances.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: "Sometimes I’m still all the way down”: How Shaquille O’Neal struggled with loneliness after his divorce from Shaunie Henderson
articles.summary: Shaquille O'Neal, one of the greatest NBA legends, has had a stellar career but his personal life has suffered through the years.
articles.body: Shaquille O'Neal, one of the greatest NBA legends, has had a stellar career but his personal life has suffered through the years. His marriage to Shaunie Henderson ended when she found out he had been cheating on her for several years. But the NBA icon has also never shied away from admitting his mistakes and it has now resurfaced.Shaquille O'Neal’s confession on how his multiple extramarital affairs ended up affecting his children and how he felt emptyIn 2022, Shaquille O'Neal made a confession on the "The Big Podcast with Shaq” where he reflected how his infidelity affected the lives of his children.The NBA legend said, "The happiest days of my life were coming home and hearing six different people saying, 'Daddy, daddy, daddy’…Happiest days of my life. Forget the money, forget the cars, even the championships. Especially when they were little and 2 [years old] and 3 and didn't really care that I missed 10, 15 free throws. They're waiting for me after games. 'Daddy, can we go to Universal?' Those were the best days of my life.”The four time NBA champion added, "When I lost those — not gonna use the 'D' word, because I know a lot of people are suffering — but I was all the way down. Sometimes I'm still all the way down. Especially when I was in my house in Orlando, which is 70,000 square feet, in there by myself. Nobody. Like I built a house for the kids — gym, game room, pool house, guest house for the mom, and all that. When I lost all that by being stupid, it killed me."In another appearance on The Pivot podcast, Shaquille O'Neal said, "I was bad. She was awesome…It was all me. We don't need to talk about what I was doing, but I wasn't protecting her and protecting those vows. Sometimes you live that double life and get caught up. I'm not going to say it was her. It was all me."Shaquille O'Neal chose not to settle down in his life again after his divorceWhile his constant infidelity ended his marriage to the mother of his children in 2010 after being together for seven years, he never remarried.Shaquille O'Neal’s ex wife, Shaunie Henderson, later moved on in her life as she tied the knot to Pastor Keion Henderson in 2022.Interestingly, after their marriage ended, Shaquille O'Neal dated several high profile women.Months after his divorce, Shaquille O'Neal started dating reality TV star Nicole Alexander and the two even moved in together and got engaged only to call it quits in 2013.The NBA legend later went on to date model Laticia Rolle for four years and actress Annie Ilonzeh.However, none of these relationships worked out for him as Shaquille O'Neal remains single for now.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.summary: Here is the game preview of the Brooklyn Nets' NBA Cup matchup against the Orlando Magic on Friday.
articles.body:
The Brooklyn Nets (3-11) are coming off their most frustrating loss of the season and as head coach Jordi Fernandez and the players put it, everyone has to do some soul-searching at this point. Brooklyn has to do something different with an NBA Cup matchup against the Orlando Magic (6-8) on Friday and if you're wondering where you can watch all the action live, you've come to the right place!

The Nets come into this game following a 137-107 loss to the Chicago Bulls on Wednesday in which the Bulls won the first quarter by a 37-21 margin and never looked back. Guard Egor Demin led the way for Brooklyn with 22 points, four rebounds, and four assists while forward Julius Randle had 17 points and four assists in what he deemed one of the worst games of his career that he's been a part of.

The Magic enter this matchup after a 121-116 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers on Wednesday in which Orlando raced out to as much as a 17-point lead in the game, but wasn't able to hold on for the victory in the end. Forward Franz Wagner led the way for the Magic with 27 points, eight rebounds, and 11 assists while guard Jalen Suggs had 18 points and eight rebounds.

Here is what you need to know to get ready for this matchup:

Location : Barclays Center, Brooklyn, NY

articles.title: Warriors' Yaxel Lendeborg breaks silence on losing streak with honest admission that raises bigger questions
articles.summary: Yaxel Lendeborg is not hiding how much the Warriors’ five-game slide hurts.
articles.body: Yaxel Lendeborg is not hiding how much the Warriors’ five-game slide hurts. The rookie scored 11 points on 3-of-11 shooting in Thursday’s 126-98 loss to Memphis, which dropped Golden State to 8-9 and ended a winless road trip. Stephen Curry has been out with an oblique injury since the trip opened. Golden State had won eight straight before it all turned. Lendeborg has now spoken about how he is handling it, including the words Draymond Green offered after the New Orleans loss and the story behind a haircut that drew attention.What did Yaxel Lendeborg say about the Warriors’ losing streak?Lendeborg opened with a simple line: “I hate losing, man.” He went on to explain that he has never dropped this many games this early. A year ago he lost three times. The season before, he said he could not even recall the number. Now he feels he is letting his teammates down, and the numbers have not helped. Lendeborg cited a 9-for-23 shooting night as an example, calling that kind of inefficiency awful and saying it makes the sting worse.The frustration showed during Monday’s loss to the Pelicans. Lendeborg sat on the bench for several minutes in the fourth quarter with a towel over his head, and teammates and coaches noticed.The drop is sharp. Two weeks ago, the 24-year-old rookie was scoring 37 and setting franchise records. On Thursday, he finished with 11 points, eight rebounds and seven assists in about 33 minutes, making three of 11 shots. He added two blocks and a steal but also turned the ball over three times. Memphis rookie Cameron Boozer, the third overall pick, went 6-for-6 for 16 points in the same game. Entering the game, the NBA had pointed out that Boozer and Lendeborg were the first pair of rookies since Larry Bird and Magic Johnson in 1979-80 to average at least 16 points, seven rebounds and three assists through 15 games.Green’s blunt advice and the haircut timingGreen pulled the rookie aside after the Pelicans game with a direct message. According to Lendeborg, the veteran told him to stop showing so much weakness, because an opponent who sees it will go at him. Lendeborg took it as a call to fix his mental side of the game.The advice arrives with the team at 8-9, a long way from the eight-game winning streak the rookie helped power not long ago.The haircut got its own explanation. Lendeborg said it looked like a reaction to the Spurs loss, but the idea had been building for a while. He wanted a restart, and he admitted the timing made it seem like something it was not.Golden State now heads home and waits on Curry, who tore his oblique in the first quarter against Houston on Nov. 11. Until Curry is back, the Warriors have to find wins without him, and Lendeborg has to find his shot again.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: Sophie Cunningham wants ‘credit’ for NBA guard’s breakout after comparison
articles.summary: Sophie Cunningham compared herself to a certain Lakers guard who broke out this week after her comments.
articles.body:
It was quite a week of hoops for Los Angeles Lakers guard Quentin Grimes who had a 22-point game, followed by a wild 47-point explosion , and then 20 against Utah on Wednesday. And maybe he has Sophie Cunningham to thank?

As you may know, the WNBA player talked on her podcast last week about how she's more like Grimes than, say, Luka Doncic on the Los Angeles Lakers. She did also say her three-point shooting is better.

A week later, she discussed how Grimes broke out: "I love him! I have nothing against him! I want these boys to be successful. And I never once said I was better than him. I have a brain, I have common sense. ... I will never say that I am better than an NBA player because that's just false."

After inviting him to her No Hesitation podcast, she added this: "I think I need to talk more smack to him, because then he's just gonna continue to do his thing. So is actually kind of the credit belonging to me a little bit?"

articles.title: Nate Ament scores career high in second NBA start
articles.summary: Nate Ament records a career high for points and rebounds in his second NBA start.
articles.body:
Portland (10-5) defeated Milwaukee (1-15), 124-114, on Thursday at Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. 13,545 were in attendance for the NBA game .

Former Vol Nate Ament made his second career start for the Bucks. He recorded career highs for points (18) and rebounds (nine) in 35 minutes. Ament converted 6-of-11 field goal attempts, 2-of-5 three-point attempts and 2-of-5 free throw attempts. He also totaled nine rebounds (six defensive).

Tyler Herro led Milwaukee in scoring with 19 points in 31 minutes. He converted 7-of-13 field goal attempts, 4-of-7 three-point attempts and 1-of-3 free throw attempts.

Portland guard Damian Lillard led all scorers with 33 points.

The Trail Blazers led for 60% of the contest. Portland's largest lead was 12 points. Milwaukee's largest lead was eight points.

The Bucks' 1-15 record is the worst start through their first 16 games of a season in franchise history.
